name: x3d-stem-chirp/v1
purpose: Chirp (x3d.STEM flagship 4). Accepting under it means: the scene is grammatical and meaningful on the fork with no known trap; every inspiral declares its model and limits; the integration closes its energy budget and is stable under refinement; the orbit follows Peters' decay laws, the chirp law, Kepler's law and the quadrupole luminosity within declared limits; the published audio crosses zero exactly as the computed strain says, with a negative control that fails; payloads inflate to their recorded bytes; the builder and integrator are the shipped ones; and a browser reproduced the builder's wave heights, played both tracks with the picture locked to the sound, and ran slow-motion playback through the scene's TimeSensor.

required_witnesses: ear: zero crossings of the real-pitch
ear: zero crossings of the three-octave

limitations: Page traps are static pattern and syntax checks of src/*.js against the X_ITE contracts the Loom has paid for (law 32); the page's browser evidence remains the behaviour witness.
Behaviour is one muted headless Chromium on one machine: wave heights, playback state and clocks, not what a listener hears (listening-test not run).
No merger or ringdown; the sound ends where the model ends (stated in every case).
The shared library lib/stemkit lies outside the candidate; its hashes are recorded in each case (external_dependencies) but not gated.
Grammar and Meaning ran on the local x3d_mcp fork checkout, not the family pin.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
